title: Treatment strategy and outcome of tibial plateau fractures
summary: Investigation of the treatment strategy and functional results after a tibial plateau fracture
conditions: Fracture of the proximal end of the tibia: Other

interventions.name:
Patients with a previous tibial plateau fracture 
Recording the outcome using standardized questionnaires every 6 months after the trauma, in total over 20 years

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Instead of a tibial plateau fracture
Exclusion criteria:
Patients younger then 18 years
